headline: Rollout of new HOA website
description: The initial version of the HOA website has been launched. Please reach out and provide feedback for areas to improve.

headline: HOA Information Packets Distributed
description: Information packets about the HOA have been distributed to all residents in person.

headline: Roundabout on Township Line Road in 2026
description: The project consists of the construction of a roundabout at the intersection of Township Line Road and Shady Lane in Plainfield, Indiana. This project located at the main entrance of Hobbs Station was issued for roundabout bids in February and March of this year and I could find no date when the road will be closed. I bet it will be sooner rather than later.

headline: A WAWA is Coming Soon
description: The old Walgreen’s site on Main Street and Dan Jones is well on the way to becoming a local gas station.

headline: The Lakin Neighborhood
description: The Lakin Neighborhood Retail development is about ½ finished. There will be an additional mirror image building as phase two to be done to the south. So far, a Graeter’s Ice Cream store with a drive through, an American Family Insurance office and a Japanese Grill House are locked into three of the five spaces. Interesting that parking is limited to 23 spaces for Phase One and that parking is only located behind the building. When Phase Two is done there are only an additional 27 parking spaces.

headline: Plainfield Christian Church
description: The Plainfield Christian Church has also started a process to rezone the commercial land to the North of the church, still non-residential. No details are available yet.
